sections.name: rulings
sections.label: Rulings
sections.content: ADR-041 section 5, owner steer 2026-07-22: multi-user or networked environments consume SRS through export/import, never a RepositoryStore over a network database; the synchronous store is a deliberate boundary. G8: SQL, graph and vector acceleration is an optional derived projection in srs-projection. Scope decision 9ec53ca2: permissions, storage/sync and transport are outside SRS. Values statement (ratified 2026-08-02): semantic sovereignty through portable data; sovereignty is structural, this is a folder.

sections.name: consequence
sections.label: Consequence
sections.content: An HTTP transport and an auth front need no RFC (transport is outside the standard) but do need an ADR-037 amendment in srs-rust. Authorization must not be encoded in records. SQL can only ever be an index.
